segments.text: Ok so this is the generative UI components page for AG2 with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, this provider and the standard UI catalog.
They come from an entry point that, umm, doesn't exist.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. It should render a product card, but uh, the agent just wrote HTML code as text.
So basically, the page says register the provider and the agent renders components, but the generative UI entry point it imports doesn't exist in the angular package.
So the app won't build, and without it nothing renders. The cart store file is never shown either.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
